input_files.driver_trip_features.csv: Step 4 output, read-only (source of optional IMU aggregates only)

methodology.approach: Transparent, rule-based, per-metric classification. NOT a blended/weighted composite score.
methodology.rule: A vehicle is 'Investigate' if ANY core metric is at/above that metric's fleet p90 (or, for gps_teleport_count, at/above 1 occurrence, since teleports are already rare/anomalous under the existing Step 3 threshold). A vehicle is 'Watch' if not Investigate but ANY core metric is at/above that metric's fleet p75. Otherwise 'Normal'.
methodology.why_no_composite_score: No weighting scheme, formula, or risk-tier definition for vehicle health exists anywhere in the approved Step 2-4 project, and the user's Step 6 instructions require not inventing thresholds/weights. A per-metric transparent rule avoids inventing a blending formula while still producing an explainable 3-tier status - every status is traceable to the exact metric(s) that triggered it (see status_trigger_reasons column).

gps_teleport_count.source: telemetry.csv:flag_gps_teleport (existing Step 3 flag, threshold gps_step_km=2.0km/60s, unchanged)
gps_teleport_count.reason_for_rule: Only 5 GPS-teleport events exist across the entire 12,987-row telemetry dataset (2/30 vehicles have any). This event was already established as rare/implausible by the existing, unmodified Step 3 threshold; with so few occurrences fleet-wide, any occurrence is itself the signal - a percentile cut on a count this sparse would not be meaningful.

speed_jump_rate_per_1000min.source: telemetry.csv:flag_speed_jump (existing Step 3 flag, threshold speed_jump_kmph=50.0, unchanged)
speed_jump_rate_per_1000min.threshold_justification: Fleet-wide p75/p90 of this rate across the current 30 vehicles.

distance_vs_gps_trip_pct.source: trips.csv:flag_distance_vs_gps (existing Step 3 flag, thresholds dist_gps_abs_km=3.0 / dist_gps_rel=0.25, unchanged)
distance_vs_gps_trip_pct.threshold_justification: Fleet-wide p75/p90 of this pct across the current 30 vehicles.

distance_vs_speed_integral_trip_pct.source: trips.csv:flag_distance_vs_speed_integral (existing Step 3 flag, threshold dist_speed_abs_km=3.0, unchanged)
distance_vs_speed_integral_trip_pct.threshold_justification: Fleet-wide p75/p90 of this pct across the current 30 vehicles. Note: this flag is common fleet-wide (fires on 243/450 trips overall per Step 3/4), so the RELATIVE rate per vehicle (30.8%-80.0% range observed) is the meaningful signal here, not the absolute presence of the flag.

dead_flags_not_usable_for_differentiatio.flag_accel_outlier: 0/12,987 telemetry rows fleet-wide - never fires, provides zero differentiating power between vehicles.
dead_flags_not_usable_for_differentiatio.flag_timestamp_gap_irregular: 0/12,987 - never fires (confirms the exact 60s telemetry grid already established in Step 3).
dead_flags_not_usable_for_differentiatio.note: These are still included in the generic sensor_flagged_minute_pct descriptive column for completeness/future-proofing, but currently contribute nothing to it and were not usable to differentiate vehicles in this dataset.

descriptive_context_column.sensor_flagged_minute_pct: 100 * (telemetry rows with ANY of the 7 existing row-level flags) / telemetry_row_count. Reported for context; NOT used in status classification (would double-count gps_teleport_count and speed_jump evidence already used directly above).

exploratory_only_features_excluded_from_.optional_accel_mag_mean_g: Vehicle-level mean of Step 4's optional_accel_mag_mean_g. Excluded from status per the same Step 4 finding: one accelerometer snapshot per minute, undocumented phone-mount orientation.
exploratory_only_features_excluded_from_.optional_imu_exploratory_flag: 1 if a vehicle's accel-magnitude variability or gyro-magnitude mean is at/above the fleet's own 90th percentile; purely informational, does not affect vehicle_health_status.

context_only_master_data_fields.Vehicle_Type: Constant across all 30 vehicles (all 'Two-Wheeler (Scooter/Motorcycle)') - zero discriminating power in this dataset.
context_only_master_data_fields.Make/Model/Manufacture_Year/Registration: Reported for transparency only. No maintenance-interval standard or age/mileage threshold exists anywhere in the source data, so these are never used to assign a status.

wording_policy: vehicle_health_status and status_trigger_reasons describe elevated sensor/data-quality signatures only. No output claims or implies confirmed mechanical failure. 'Investigate'/'Watch' should be read as 'sensor signature warrants inspection', not as a fault diagnosis.
notes: No dashboard built in this step.
Step 5 outputs (driver_safety_scores.csv, safety_score_summary.json, safety_score_validation_checks.csv) and their methodology were not modified.
processed/*.csv (Step 2 files) not read or modified.
